title: LA Rams, Trent McDuffie have just set the market for Seahawks’ Devon Witherspoon

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: LA Rams, Trent McDuffie have just set the market for Seahawks’ Devon Witherspoon
sources.description: Trent McDuffie is now the NFL’s highest paid corner, which is something to monitor for Devon Witherspoon and the Seahawks.
